## Technical Profile & Biography
Divyesh Soni is a highly skilled Full Stack Software Engineer and AI Builder based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. He specializes in designing and building production-grade web applications, interactive interfaces, and intelligent SaaS solutions. 

His engineering philosophy focuses on high scalability, clean architecture, responsive layouts, fluid micro-interactions, and tight type safety.

- **Location:** Ahmedabad, India (IST time zone)
- **Role Interest:** Full-Time & Internship Roles (Immediate Availability, Remote/Hybrid/On-site)
- **Primary Domain:** Full Stack Web Development, Generative AI Agentic Pipelines, Interactive Web Design

## Detailed Tech Stack & Competencies

### 1. Frontend Engineering
- **Core Frameworks:** React.js (Advanced), Next.js 14 (Advanced, App Router, React Server Components)
- **Languages:** TypeScript (Advanced), JavaScript (Advanced)
- **Styling & Layout:** Tailwind CSS (Expert), HTML5 (Expert), CSS3 (Expert)
- **Motion & Interactions:** Framer Motion (Intermediate), Three.js (WebGL, Basic to Intermediate)

### 2. Backend & Databases
- **Runtime & Frameworks:** Node.js (Advanced), Express.js (Advanced)
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL (Intermediate), MongoDB (Intermediate), Firebase (Intermediate)
- **ORMs:** Prisma ORM (Advanced)
- **APIs & Protocols:** REST APIs (Advanced), Server-Sent Events (SSE), JSON Web Tokens (JWT Auth)

### 3. AI & LLM Integrations
- **APIs:** Claude API (Anthropic), OpenAI API, Google Gemini API
- **AI Paradigms:** Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Chaining, Streamed Code Generation

### 4. DevOps & Tooling
- **Version Control:** Git / GitHub (Advanced)
- **Hosting & Deployment:** Vercel (Advanced)
- **Containers:** Docker (Intermediate)

## Portfolio Projects

### 1. VELVET.AI (AI & SaaS)
- **Role:** Creator / Lead Engineer
- **Description:** An AI-powered SaaS website builder that generates production-ready web applications from natural language prompts using Anthropic's Claude. It orchestrates a multi-step prompt-chaining generation pipeline.
- **Key Metrics:** 45% perceived latency reduction through real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming. 90%+ structural generation accuracy.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 14, Claude API, Prisma ORM, TypeScript, SSE
- **GitHub / Live Links:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Divyezh)

### 2. Ojas Hospital (Healthcare)
- **Role:** Full Stack Developer
- **Description:** A modern multispecialty healthcare management portal & patient booking system featuring doctor directory scheduling, OPD appointment scheduling, real-time patient queue, and department telemetry.
- **Key Metrics:** Live deployment serving active healthcare staff and patients.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs
- **Live Link:** [Ojas Hospital](https://www.ojashospitalmultispecility.com/)

### 3. Arijit World (Interactive Web)
- **Role:** Frontend Engineer
- **Description:** An immersive interactive musical portal and discography experience for fans of artist Arijit Singh. Features dynamic HTML Web Audio API visualizers, concert tour timelines, and custom playlist generators.
- **Key Metrics:** Highly praised audio visualizer and cinematically synced UI.
- **Tech Stack:** React, Next.js, Web Audio API, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS
- **Live Link:** [Arijit World](https://arijit-world.vercel.app/)

### 4. Interactive Portfolio (Interactive Web)
- **Role:** Personal Site Developer
- **Description:** A high-performance personal developer portfolio showcasing interactive 3D particle systems and GPU-accelerated motion. Redesigned to feature a warm sunset & plum color aesthetic (Peach, Coral, Rose, Plum, and Dark Violet tones).
- **Key Metrics:** 100% responsive, high-performance WebGL integrations, smooth preloader.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 14, Three.js, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS
- **Code Link:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Divyezh/Divyesh-portfolio)
- **Live Link:** [divyesh.dev](https://divyesh.dev)
